name: A Donation of Wool

angles.text: Contributing raw materials strengthens Alliance solidarity and helps sustain a vital ally displaced from its mountain home.
For exiled gnomes, gathering wool helps resupply your displaced kin as they survive and rebuild outside Gnomeregan.
Tailors who gather or weave wool cloth have an ample supply of textiles that refugee populations need for basic garments and supplies.

faq.answer: The Gnomeregan Exiles are gathering basic textile supplies. Driven from their home city, their refugee population needs wool cloth to sustain its people and ongoing operations.
faq.q: Why do the Gnomeregan Exiles need wool cloth?

faq.answer: The drive asks each contributor for sixty pieces of wool cloth. The organizers count on contributions from across the realm to meet their supply needs.
faq.q: How much wool cloth is needed?

faq.answer: Representatives of the Gnomeregan Exiles organize the collection and receive donations for the displaced gnomes sheltering among their allies.
faq.q: Who is organizing this donation drive?

faq.answer: Each donor is asked for one contribution of sixty pieces. The exiles need that fixed amount from you and rely on contributors across the realm to meet their quota.
faq.q: Can you donate wool cloth more than once?

faq.answer: Donating sixty pieces earns recognition and gratitude from the Gnomeregan Exiles. It shows your loyalty and support for their displaced people in a time of crisis.
faq.q: What recognition do the Gnomeregan Exiles offer?

faq.answer: The gnomes fled their subterranean home in Gnomeregan after a catastrophic disaster and trogg invasion. As refugees, they depend on temporary encampments, aid from allies, and material drives.
faq.q: Why are the gnomes currently in exile?

sections.body:
Gnomeregan's fall to trogg invaders and radioactive contamination drove its surviving gnomes from their high-tech city. They now live as refugees, hosted chiefly by their dwarven cousins in Ironforge.

Outside their ancestral halls, the Gnomeregan Exiles face severe strain in supplying their people. Regular drives for cloth and other basics help keep them clothed, supplied, and organized.
sections.title: A Displaced People's Needs

sections.body: The drive asks each volunteer for exactly sixty pieces of wool cloth. By gathering modest contributions from across the realm, the exiles can collect the textiles they need for bedding, bandages, and clothing without overburdening any one supplier. Those who aid their recovery receive formal recognition among their people.
sections.title: The Textile Drive

summary: Across the realm, A Donation of Wool calls for aid to the Gnomeregan Exiles. Driven from Gnomeregan, they need wool cloth to sustain their displaced people. Sixty pieces earn formal recognition among the gnomes.
